scenario: Concurrent shipping cost calculation with shared mutable cache
input_format: List[Dict[str, Any]] representing orders with id, amount, region, priority, items
output_format: List[Dict[str, Any]] with id, shipping_cost, discounted_amount, region, timestamp
flaky_behavior: Original implementation uses unsynchronized shared state, random latency, and time-based discounts causing inconsistent outputs and runtime failures
mitigation: Optimized implementation introduces deterministic seeding, locking, immutable data classes, deterministic clocks, and stable threading semantics
